emotional_tone: Trustworthy, professional, highly capable, privacy-focused, objective, dense but readable

rules.anti_default_rule: Inter and generic sans are banned for headings. Using IBM Plex Mono to establish a serious, engineering-grade aesthetic.

colors.strategy: Deep navy / petrol anchor with bright blue accent. Restrained contrast, avoiding generic AI purple/blue gradients.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid Protocol. Information-dense, modular, and compact.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tighter than standard SaaS. Use p-2, p-3, p-4 for internal components. p-4 to p-6 for main sections.
layout_and_spacing.surface_styles: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). 1px solid borders separating panels. Zero border-radius for main panels, max 4px for inner elements like buttons/tags.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layouts.

components.strategy: Shadcn heavily customized for IDE-native density. No excessive padding. Cardless design (rectangular, dense).

agent_roster_panel.description: Multi-agent team with status and role avatars.
agent_roster_panel.visuals: List view. Small square avatars or crisp icons (Phosphor/Lucide). Status dots (green/amber) blinking softly. Role text in monospace.

activity_log.visuals: Terminal-style list. Monospace timestamps. Left-aligned, extremely dense (py-1). No chat-bubbles. Pure structured logs.

plan_viewer.visuals: Tree-view or numbered steps. Clear left-border tracking the active step (accent color). Checkboxes for completion.

diff_preview.visuals: Split pane or inline diff. Red/Green subtle backgrounds. Strict monospace. Prominent 'Approve' / 'Reject' floating action bar.

mock_ai_provider.visuals: Command-line like input at bottom. Clean message thread above. No avatars for user, just clear text separation.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Background lightens slightly. Border color shifts to accent. Text must remain high contrast.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Instant or 150ms ease-out. No bouncy spring animations.

icons_and_assets.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for technical feel)

agent_avatars.description: Abstract minimalist dark avatar for agent representation
Abstract wave dark avatar for secondary agent

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all panels have strict 1px borders with border-[#2A3F6C] to create a 'skeleton' layout.
No large border radii. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none to maintain IDE aesthetics.
Do NOT use any gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors from the palette.
Implement the layout as a collapsible sidebar (left) and main editor area (right).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
For the Diff Preview, use exact diff colors: addition is bg-emerald-500/15 with emerald-400 text, deletion is bg-red-500/15 with red-400 text.
Activity Log must look like a system audit trail (monospace timestamps, dense layout), NOT a consumer chatbot.
